description: Deterministic procedural layering for 3D space: seeded noise, SDF composition, terrain fields, surface-map bakes, scalar relief profiles, and optional Three.js adapters.
rules: Install strata-procedural; Strata Procedural is the project name, not the npm package name.
Import only from strata-procedural or its declared public subpaths; do not suggest deep imports.

Keep noise, SDF, terrain, materials, shaders, and surface-fields renderer-neutral. Built-in random generators use explicit seeds; caller-supplied samplers must be deterministic and independent of call order.
Treat three and r3f as optional adapters: they may convert supplied data but must not own generation, a render loop, or application state.
Use the API documentation for the current public surface and do not claim unimplemented mesh extraction, runtime world management, or image encoding.
